Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.paper

Class PaperSuggestions

java.lang.Object
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.paper.PaperSuggestions
public final class PaperSuggestions extends Object
Brigadier suggestion support shared by every generated Paper command wrapper.

Keeping the input handling here means a generated wrapper only states which provider answers for an argument, instead of repeating the argument splitting and filtering for every command.
